name: Facet
text: Add a floating, always-visible legend that updates in real time as the user hovers over data points. This keeps the user’s focus on the graph while ensuring they never lose context, which beats a collapsible sidebar for speed and clarity. The trade-off is screen space, but the gain in uninterrupted exploration outweighs it.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A floating legend that hides controls when data points cluster near the edge risks trapping users in a dead zone—no legend, no context. A better alternative: a sticky legend anchored to the viewport edge, with a toggle to collapse it when space is tight. Settle it with a usability test: measure task completion time with both designs and ask users to rate clarity.
